summary: Executed full backend API pytest suite (25 tests) covering services, auth (register/user-login/admin-login/me), bookings (cash+stripe), receipts (owner-scoped access + 403 for other users), Stripe checkout + status, admin endpoints (bookings, mark-paid, analytics shape, users), super-admin create-admin (+RBAC 403), and AI OCR receipt scan via GPT-5.4 (real receipt-like JPEG). All 25/25 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: mixing async motor and sync pymongo in Stripe flow — payment_status endpoint uses sync_db inside an async handler which will block the event loop under load; consider moving to motor.

server.py: /api/payments/status/{session_id} is unauthenticated (no Depends(get_current_user)); any caller with a session_id can trigger Stripe retrieval and booking mark-paid. Consider requiring auth and ownership check.
server.py: /api/receipts/scan does not validate image MIME/size before sending to LLM — could be abused with huge payloads.
server.py: DEFAULT_SERVICES seeds only 4 items but the model accepts a 5th 'custom' category — seed intent vs model union is fine, just note in docs.
seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral TEST_ users (phones prefixed +1555.../+1666...) and one temporary admin (auto-deleted). Cash + stripe bookings + receipts created against the seeded super admin/services. Super admin seeded automatically by backend startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — pytest-based, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. TestOCR requires EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and does a live GPT-5.4 vision call (~5-10s). Test users are created with unique phones each run so re-runs are safe. Stripe checkout test verifies checkout_url + session_id creation only (doesn't complete payment).
